# Charger Mechatronic Vietnam (CMV)

> CÔNG TY TNHH CHARGER MECHATRONIC (tax code 0319206171), Ho Chi Minh City. Vietnam entity of Charger Mechatronic Co., Ltd. (Taiwan, founded 2005). Control systems and retrofits for metal-cutting lines: rotary/flying shear, cut-to-length, slitting, tube cutting and bending. Exclusive official distributor of NUSCO (Japan) in Vietnam.

## Key pages
- [Rotary shear retrofit (Vietnamese)](https://mu4540.github.io/cmv-site/cai-tao-may-cat-bay.html): typical case ±0.3 → ±0.1 mm, output +20%, braking energy reused
- [Rotary shear retrofit (English)](https://mu4540.github.io/cmv-site/en/rotary-shear-retrofit.html)
- [Flying shear control](https://mu4540.github.io/cmv-site/dieu-khien-may-cat-bay.html)
- [Cut-to-length line control](https://mu4540.github.io/cmv-site/dieu-khien-day-chuyen-cat-tam.html)
- [Slitting line control](https://mu4540.github.io/cmv-site/dieu-khien-may-xa-bang.html)
- [Tube cutting and bending control](https://mu4540.github.io/cmv-site/dieu-khien-may-cat-ong.html)
- [飛剪改造 (Traditional Chinese)](https://mu4540.github.io/cmv-site/zh-tw/rotary-shear-retrofit.html)
- [CMV 越南 (Traditional Chinese overview)](https://mu4540.github.io/cmv-site/zh-tw/index.html)
